Package com.example.fastwriting.controller

Class GameController

java.lang.Object
com.example.fastwriting.controller.GameController
public class GameController extends Object
Controller of the game view (game-view.fxml).

It connects the view with the model and handles all the events of the game:

  • Keyboard events: Enter validates the answer, Escape clears it, and every key released gives live feedback while typing.
  • Mouse events: clicks on the buttons and hover effects.
  • Timer events: received through an anonymous class that extends the adapter TimerAdapter.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Juan José Montaño Dosman, Anthony Alejandro Mora, Roiban Alirio Rosales Bastidas

    GameController.AnswerKeyHandler
    Inner class that handles the keys pressed in the answer field: Enter validates the answer and Escape clears it.

    GameController.HoverHandler
    Inner class that handles the mouse hover on the buttons: the button grows a little and the cursor changes to a hand.
    private class 
    GameController.TypingFeedbackHandler
    Inner class that gives live feedback while the player types: the border of the field is blue while the text matches the beginning of the word, and red as soon as there is a mistake.

    • validateAnswer

      private void validateAnswer()
      Validates the answer when the player presses Enter or the button. A wrong answer does not lose the level: the player can try again while there is time left.

    • handleTimeUp

      private void handleTimeUp()
      Called when the time is over: the answer is validated automatically. If it is wrong or empty, the game ends.
